name: 12nin no Onna Kyoushi
source:
Main character transfers to an elite boys' school where his uncle becomes a president. They decide to use women teachers as a bait to attract the best students. For that protagonist develops a plan to train teachers into slaves.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-january-2003-moekan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角转学到一所精英男子学校，他的叔叔在那里成为校长。他们决定用女教师作为诱饵来吸引最优秀的学生。因为主角制定了一项将教师训练成奴隶的计划。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-january-2003-moekan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
